{{Top|leg}}
'''Tillin&#39;natiri''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who once ran a con where they and their companions would dress as [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and "confiscate" cargo from other smugglers. However, they could only procure [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifles]] for the ruse rather than [[Freedom One/Legends|Stormtrooper Ones]], causing at least one mark to figure out the con. Tillin&#39;natiri detailed the scam on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]], where fellow smuggler [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] realized he had also been a victim of the con.<ref name="Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
